english.text: It is the 21st of January of 2017. I have been travelling vicariously via Street View on my iMaps+ app on my Apple iPad mini. I have seen much of this world. english.text: The study in the journal PLOS Biology lists what the authors say are the world's 10 most charismatic animals: tigers, lions, elephants, giraffes, leopards, pandas, cheetahs, polar bears, gray wolves and gorillas. The common depiction of these animals in cartoons and movies and as toys has led to what the authors call "virtual populations" — people believe the animals are not at risk of extinction in the wild because they appear to be everywhere.

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: One boy was retarded. However, being a retard, he didn't know he was retarded, and so lived a happy and rather pleasant life. Another boy was very smart, but, the way smart people tend to be, was constantly soul-searching in anguish, hence lived a life of anxiety and insecurity. One day they met. "Life is great!" proclaimed the retard boy. "That's questionable," the smart boy replied. "Why?" asked the retard boy. And the smart boy went on to expatiate about the laws of dialectics, philosophy, and other matters beyond the retard boy's comprehension. The retard boy listened to the smart boy's speech intently, then shrugged and said, "Are you retarded?"

text: 有一個細路係弱智。不過因為佢弱智，佢唔知自己弱智，所以過住開心又幾舒服嘅人生。另一個細路好醒目，但就好似好多醒目人咁，成日喺度痛苦咁尋找人生意義、心靈探索，所以成日活得焦慮同冇安全感。有一日佢哋相遇咗。「人生好正呀！」弱智細路興奮咁宣佈。「呢個有得質疑。」醒目細路回應。「點解呀？」弱智細路問。醒目細路就開始長篇大論，講辯證法規律、哲學，同其他弱智細路完全聽唔明嘅嘢。弱智細路好認真咁聽晒佢講完，之後聳聳肩噉話：「你係唔係弱智呀？」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: A communist dies, and since he was an honest man, albeit atheistic, he is sentenced to rotate spending one year in Hell and one year in Heaven. One year passes, and Satan tells God, "Take this man as fast as possible, because he turned all my young demons into Young Pioneers; I have to restore some order." Another year passes. "Lord God, it's my turn now," Satan reminds. God replies, "First of all, don't call me Lord God, but instead Comrade God; second, there is no God; and one more thing – don't distract me, or I'll be late to the Party meeting."

text: 有個共產黨員死咗，因為佢份人雖然係無神論者，但生前都算老實，所以最後被判「一年住地獄，一年住天堂」咁樣輪流轉。一年過去，撒旦頂唔順走去同上帝講：「你快啲帶走呢個人啦！佢將我下面啲後生魔鬼全部變晒做『少先隊』，搞到我而家要大費周章去重整紀律呀！」又一年過去，撒旦又返嚟提醒上帝：「上帝大佬，而家輪到我接手嗰個人喇。」點知上帝回頭望一望佢，冷靜啲噉講：「第一，唔好嗌我做『上帝大佬』，要嗌『上帝同志』；第二，呢個世界根本就冇上帝；第三，你唔好喺度騷擾我，如果唔係我趕唔切去參加『黨支部會議』呀！」
